at: Prince Chunchu (45) approaches the Second Emperor
alt: Dawn audience: Chunchu walks up the aisle between bowed lines of officials toward the Second Emperor, enthroned high in darkness, his shadow filling the screen behind him
scene: 2:1 drama court shot, composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop. LOW DOLLY at knee height behind and below CHUNCHU as he walks up the central aisle of the audience hall, small in the lower third. Hard cold blue dawn backlight from the open doors behind us throws his long shadow up the aisle. Either side, two lines of Tang officials in dark robes and black futou caps bow deep, ivory tablets raised, faces hidden. ONE device: a steep stair of the dais rising out of the dark at the far end to a throne alcove that is a cave of black — and in it THE SECOND EMPEROR, seated high above the whole hall, knees wide, hands on his knees, massive and utterly still. Behind him his own shadow is thrown up onto the painted screen, enormous, filling the whole back wall. The whole hall leans toward him. Polished dark floor reflecting the two lamp-trees. Incense haze in the dawn shafts. No writing.
